text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki is injured during training,
so I
hastily escort her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... It seems the state of my injury is
more
unfavorable than I first thought.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That said,
even if I have to suffer pain, I
must
continue making progress.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
They do say that a clear head remains
cool amidst
any blaze. I ask that you
allow me to continue my
training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'll endeavor not to strain myself while
running, so
please...
choice_data_list: Let's do some proper training once...
Let's do it without overdoing it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I see. If I push on with my training, it
could have
the opposite effect and set
me back...
choice_data_list: You might develop bad habits in yo...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I shall focus on recuperating
until I'm
back to full health.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki sounds disappointed as
she heads
back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for understanding. Let's hurry
back to
the track!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although I only tasked her with a light
run to
check her condition, Yaeno
Muteki's face
contorts with pain.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly sorry for the trouble. I'll take
your advice
to heart and rest for the
remainder of the day.
choice_data_list: Let's call off training after all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm ashamed indeed to have made such a

disgraceful display...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki appears to be in a lot of
pain as
she slowly makes her way back
to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Whew... It seems I'll manage as long as
the
exercise isn't especially demanding.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'll stick to light training of this
nature
until my
body is fully recovered!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki completes a light training
session
while taking care not to
aggravate her injury.
